issues.title: Files land in Android/data workspaces, not in the Documents root
issues.detail: The required root is /storage/emulated/0/Documents/OpenCode/<project>. Some chats wrote to storage/emulated/0/Android/data/<app>/files/workspaces/<n>/, others to Documents/OpenCode/mobile-N. Needs an owner decision and a check.
